6442072036be4539.description: About Tronox Tronox is a global leader in the vertically integrated manufacturing of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that enhance the brightness and durability of everyday products. With a workforce of 5,700 individuals across six continents, Tronox is guided by a strong set of values. The company is dedicated to responsibly transforming earth's resources into products and opportunities that improve lives, with a vision to shape a sustainable world through enriched and refined minerals. The Role of Process Engineer Tronox is seeking a Process Engineer to join its team in Al Madinah, specifically in Yanbu or Medina. This full-time role is responsible for coordinating daily technical support and short-term technical improvements for SQLCST. The Process Engineer will focus on optimizing and designing processes to enhance efficiency, safety, and product quality sustainably. This involves analyzing production workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing technical solutions to reduce costs and improve throughput. The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations while driving continuous improvement initiatives. 6431fe377b1a1d9b.description: About the Role Caliberly is seeking an Operations Supervisor with 5-7 years of experience to oversee and coordinate drilling operations for geological and geotechnical projects. The successful candidate will manage drilling crews, ensure operational efficiency, maintain safety standards, and deliver high-quality drilling results in line with project requirements. Ensure correct rig setup, alignment, and drilling practices for various formations. Monitor drilling performance, penetration rates, and core recovery to optimize efficiency. Troubleshoot technical and operational problems, including stuck rods, fluid loss, and unstable formations. Lead and manage drilling crews, ensuring clear communication of tasks and responsibilities. 64a3308e133bae42.job_title: Manager Data & AI Portfolio & Project Management

Through domain stewardship and collaboration with stakeholders, the role strengthens operational performance, supports innovation, and enhances organizational data maturity. Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions that generate measurable business outcomes. Influence enterprise data architecture decisions to improve interoperability and domain integration. Promote industry-leading practices, technologies, and methodologies across the data ecosystem. Build partnerships between business functions, digital teams, and external partners to align priorities and outcomes. 64a8f82baeb60745.job_title: Senior Manager - Fire and Life Safety Operation
64a8f82baeb60745.description: The Senior Manager - Fire, Life and Safety is responsible for overseeing all fire prevention, life safety, and emergency preparedness operations across Qiddiya's city assets. This role ensures that fire safety systems, evacuation procedures, and life safety protocols meet the highest international standards, safeguarding guests, employees, and infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Oversee the operational readiness and performance of all fire detection, suppression, and alarm systems across Qiddiya's portfolio of assets. Develop, implement, and maintain fire safety and life safety management plans, SOPs, and emergency evacuation procedures. Conduct regular fire risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections to ensure compliance with Saudi Civil Defence regulations and international best practices. Coordinate fire safety training programs, evacuation drills, and awareness campaigns for operational staff and tenant stakeholders. Professional certifications such as NEBOSH Fire Safety, IFE membership, or equivalent are strongly preferred. Proven leadership experience managing fire safety teams and coordinating with regulatory authorities. Strong analytical skills with experience conducting fire risk assessments and safety audits.

648fa63fee4fb95f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة كوفي مريا شوكولات عن طاهي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحضير وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة، مع ضمان جودة الأطباق ونظافة بيئة العمل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الطهي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وتحضيرها وطهي اللحوم والدجاج والخضراوات والأسماك وغيرها من الأطعمة لإعداد الأطباق المدرجة في قائمة الطعام. تحضير الشوربات وإعداد السلطات والمقبلات الباردة والساخنة. سلق وطهي الأطعمة الشرقية بمهارة. تجهيز الأكلات بعد نضوجها ووضعها في الأواني المناسبة وتحضيرها للتقديم. متابعة إجراءات تنظيف المطبخ والأدوات، والإشراف على نظافة أدوات الطبخ والطعام، والمحافظة على تعليمات السلامة والصحة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الطهي، ويفضل أن تكون في الفنادق أو المطاعم أو النوادي. معرفة قوية بأساليب تحضير وطهي مختلف أنواع الأطعمة، بما في ذلك اللحوم والدواجن والأسماك والخضراوات. القدرة على إعداد الشوربات والسلطات والمقبلات والأطعمة الشرقية. المهارات والكفاءات الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحضير الأطباق وتقديمها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الطاهي ضمن فريق المطبخ لضمان تقديم أطباق عالية الجودة لعملاء المؤسسة. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. على المهتمين تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة كوفي مريا شوكولات.

6445db492b817cff.description: About the Role GDC Middle East (الشركة السعودية لتهيئة وصيانة الطائرات) is seeking a UH60 Mechanic to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves performing essential aircraft maintenance tasks on the UH-60M, adhering to OEM manuals and relevant directives. There is potential for future training and transfer to an AH-6i mechanic position. Key Responsibilities Ensure UH-60M aircraft maintenance functional activities and procedures are planned, coordinated, integrated, and synchronized to achieve operational readiness objectives. Comply with established maintenance systems, processes, procedures, and reports to provide immediate situational awareness of platform readiness rates. Establish daily maintenance operational goals, objectives, and priorities to achieve stated readiness rates and MNG training objectives. Oversee the daily maintenance management of individually assigned aircraft in support of the Production Control (PC) Manager. Work within maintenance quality control processes, procedures, and standards. Service and lubricate aircraft systems, subsystems, and components. Prepare aircraft for inspections and maintenance checks. Perform scheduled and unscheduled aircraft maintenance actions. Utilize common measuring tools, precision measuring gauges, and alignment fixtures. Conduct routine and special inspections of aircraft and related components. Perform maintenance operational checks. Diagnose and troubleshoot aircraft subsystems using special tools and equipment as required. Use and perform operator maintenance on tools, special tools, and Aircraft Ground Support Equipment (AGSE). Prepare aircraft maintenance forms and records. Ensure all related operations are conducted in a safe manner. Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in aircraft maintenance. Proficiency in performing maintenance tasks on the UH-60M aircraft. Familiarity with OEM Operators Manual, Maintenance Test Flight Manual, Check List Manual, and other pertinent directives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on maintaining operational readiness for UH-60M aircraft within a structured maintenance framework. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to critical aircraft maintenance operations.

643afc28db1e6917.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes. As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem. Why this role matters At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and own problems from beginning to end . You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration. You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers . You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption. What You'll Do Own design problems end-to-end. You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration. Turn ambiguity into clarity. Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve. Design for outcomes, not outputs. You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working. Partner closely with Product and Engineering. You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer. Raise the quality of our products. You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different. Bring customer evidence into design decisions. You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion. Make complex products feel simple. Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster. Design thoughtfully for our market. You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region. Communicate your thinking clearly. You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only what you designed but why you made those decisions. Make the team better. You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area. Who You Are You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step. You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward. You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer. You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished. You're comfortable challenging the status quo. If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence. You know when to push and when to compromise. You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints. You're highly collaborative. You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process. You're comfortable with ambiguity and change. Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process. You're genuinely curious about users. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong. You communicate with clarity. You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive. You care about quality. You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when “good enough to learn” is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated. You have 3–5 years of product design or UX/UI experience , ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking. You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices. You're a Saudi national , as this position is designated for Saudi nationals. Nice to Have Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products. Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents. Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences. Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools. What the hiring process will look like Recruiter screening — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next. Design interview — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems. Portfolio / case study presentation — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes. Team / culture interview — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team. Final interview — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team.

6488a4871b4e9286.description: About Parrot Analytics Parrot Analytics is the global authority on media and entertainment intelligence, providing the strategic decision support that the world’s leading studios, producers, streamers, investors, and government bodies rely on to de-risk content investment and maximize returns. Trusted across the full media economy — from studios and streaming platforms to film funds, sports leagues, and government bodies — Parrot Analytics informs capital allocation, acquisitions, programming strategy, and IP valuation at the highest levels of the industry. By measuring the demand and preferences of more than 2 billion audiences worldwide, Parrot Analytics’ AI platform quantifies the value of content, talent, franchises, and sports rights — enabling partners to forecast revenue, assess risk, optimize portfolio strategy, and drive more predictable success. About the Role The global entertainment industry invests hundreds of billions of dollars into film and television content every year. Yet investment decisions are still largely made using fragmented market signals, limited financial modelling, and incomplete audience insight. Parrot Analytics is building a new analytical layer for the industry — combining the world’s largest dataset on global audience demand with structured financial modelling to help studios, investors, and funds make more disciplined content investment decisions.
